review_policy: This file contains public-source research candidates. It must not write directly to canonical deals, experts, companies or graph relationships.

scope.objective: Begin a deal-led census of major and recent investments across the three TowerBrook themes.
scope.methodology: Tier 1 landmark investments plus material recent investments, prioritized by structural materiality, current activity and missing-information value.

score_method.research_priority: 45% structural materiality + 40% current activity + 15% missing-information value
score_method.structural_materiality: Value band + theme relevance + control/platform significance + strategic significance + actor importance + follow-on impact
score_method.current_activity: Recency + pending/recent status + follow-on impact + actor momentum + fresh source signals
